disorder-name.detail: Chronic schizophrenia; diagnostic criteria referenced from prior publications (refs 21–23 in paper: Utrecht Schizophrenia project and GROUP consortium protocols); longitudinal clinical cohort with baseline and follow-up scans.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "One dataset is not publicly available and consisted of a large longitudinal sample of individuals with schizophrenia and healthy participants aged 16-68 years (at baseline) from the Utrecht Schizophrenia project and the Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis (GROUP) consortium."

dataset-of-origin.detail: The clinical cohort was drawn from two sources: the Utrecht Schizophrenia project and the Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis (GROUP) consortium. Both are combined into one longitudinal clinical dataset.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "...from the Utrecht Schizophrenia project and the Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis (GROUP) consortium."

age.detail: Mean (SD) for the schizophrenia group at baseline from Table 1A: 29.90 (9.31). Min=16, max=68 refer to the full clinical dataset (HC + SCZ combined) as stated in the Methods section; SCZ-specific min/max not separately reported.
age.supporting_text: "aged 16-68 years (at baseline)"; Table 1A — Schizophrenia Baseline Age (years): 29.90 (9.31)
age.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Methods / Sample, L54; Table 1A, L73

sex.detail: Table 1A reports female N=38 (22.8%) for the schizophrenia baseline group (N=167). Male N=129 derived by subtraction (167 − 38 = 129); male % = 77.2% derived accordingly.
